integrity: The all-distance statement is proved by an explicit nine-residue projective construction plus the Griesmer lower bound. Finite verification checks the geometric bases and lifts through distance 1000 but is not used as an infinite proof. Initial Singleton-optimal cases already covered by earlier literature are identified explicitly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ternary linear all-symbol locality at most 2 in dimension three. It gives exact minimum lengths but does not classify all optimal multisets, nonlinear codes, higher dimensions, or locality 1.
title: Complete ternary dimension-three locality-\(2\) length profile
